issues.title: The $100 week
issues.summary: A hurricane, a war scare and a barrel of oil that refused to come down. How it travelled from the Gulf of Mexico to the bond market, Wall Street and bitcoin.

sections.p: Hurricane Isaias shut in nearly 63% of Gulf of Mexico oil output while traders feared new strikes on Iran. Brent crude touched $105.92 a barrel and never fell below $100.
The US 10-year Treasury yield ended the week at 5.24%, close to its highest since 2002. Markets see about an 80% chance of another Fed hike in December.
The S&P 500 set a record on Tuesday, then AI shares sold off on Thursday after a report that OpenAI earns less than assumed. The Dow still gained 1.15% on the week.
SpaceX agreed to buy US mobile airwaves. Tower owner Crown Castle rose 15.6% on Friday; T-Mobile US fell 13.3%.
Bitcoin fell 2.81% to $82,123, ending a three-week winning run. Gold rose to about $4,183 an ounce on Friday.
13 Oct: Citigroup, JPMorgan and Wells Fargo report. 14 Oct: US inflation data. 3 Nov: US midterm elections.
